segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I wanted to review the 42-seat expansion for the support team and make sure the dates still line up for your March 18 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's still the date. We're adding 18 agents in Phoenix and 6 team leads, so 42 total seats is right. My main question is the invoice timing.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. The added seats would start billing on March 15, prorated through your current term, which ends November 30. That comes to $18,420 for the remainder of the term.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the analytics add-on we talked about, or is that separate?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Included. It's listed as one line for the 42 seats with analytics enabled. No separate platform fee, and the services package is the same $4,800 onboarding block we discussed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Procurement will ask about payment terms. Our standard is net 45, not net 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, net 45 is already supported on your account, so the order form will reflect that. We can keep the existing master terms and just add this as an amendment.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. For rollout, can your team do admin training the week of March 4? We have managers out the following week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, I have March 5 or March 7 open for a 90-minute admin session. If you pick one, I'll include it in the kickoff notes so the implementation lead has the seat count, locations, and training date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let's do March 7 at 1:00 Eastern. Send the order form to me and copy Luis in procurement.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You'll have the order form this afternoon with the $18,420 prorated subscription, $4,800 onboarding, net 45 terms, and March 7 training noted. If you sign by Friday, we're set for March 15 activation.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. I'll watch for it and get Luis moving on the PO.
